steps.name: Authorize release and identify target
steps.required: Name the responsible operator, production host/webroot, actual ColdFusion edition/build, DB engine/version/name and approved credential access. Record current source revision/file hashes. Do not infer target compatibility from local MySQL8/CF2025 or historical Hostek descriptions.

steps.name: Prove delivery exclusions
steps.required: Use deployment-allowlist.json. Obtain the actual tool's dry-run/exported transfer list; verify no snapshots/dumps/test endpoints/fixtures/credentials/internal review records. Existing .gitignore does not establish SFTP/FTPS exclusion. Do not overwrite server-owned private files/uploads or use blanket remote deletion.

steps.name: Migration preflight
steps.required: Run read-only preflight on the verified target. For a new installation require READY_FOR_NEW_MIGRATION, seven InnoDB parent tables, INT identifiers compatible with new signed INT columns, route_instances.routegen_inputs_json, and supported JSON_VALID/CHECK behavior. Inspect COLUMN_TYPE and character/collation details, not integer display widths. If guide_route_imports already exists, STOP; run verify and compare schema rather than rerunning up.

steps.name: Fresh external backup before target migration
steps.required: Back up the selected target using the established operational credential mechanism to a protected path outside every public root. Record size/hash, gzip integrity, restoration procedure and access controls. A backup download must not be accessible by HTTP. Retain current application/configuration snapshots outside delivery scope. The Nov7 local backup is insufficient for new target or post-import rollback.

steps.name: Apply additive migration once
steps.required: After separate production DB authorization, use a client that stops on errors. Run up once, then verify. Require20 columns, both unique indexes, InnoDB and zero invalid JSON rows. Review request_history_json/check constraints and identifier types explicitly. Never delete or seed shared ports, segments, templates, routes or Beta Program records.

steps.name: Runtime, fonts and licensing
steps.required: Use root-owned font/runtime runbook and prepared Dockerfile patch. Verify target CF engine build and datasource behavior; obtain explicit approval for external Docker/config changes and base image acquisition. A running-container package install does not survive rebuild. Check required fonts/native libraries in a recreated approved environment, actual guide+nonguide PDF rendering, glyphs, embedded fonts and merge behavior. Verify production license separately from Developer/Trial watermark. Confirm datasource long-text retrieval (CLOB) is enabled: local fpw originally had disable_clob=true/buffer64000 and truncated long guide_context; approved correction now enables CLOB. See deployment-datasource-clob.json. Preserve existing credentials, BLOB and all unrelated settings.

prepared_mysql_commands.warning: NOT EXECUTED. Run only on explicitly approved target with variables supplied by the operator and existing approved mysql login-path credentials; no credential contents are read here. Do not use --force. Resolve preflight findings before continuing.
prepared_mysql_commands.preflight:
set -euo pipefail
: "${FPW_RELEASE_DB:?Set the independently verified FPW or fpw target database}"
: "${FPW_RELEASE_LOGIN_PATH:?Set the existing approved mysql login path}"
: "${FPW_RELEASE_SOURCE:?Set the reviewed checkout path}"
case "$FPW_RELEASE_DB" in FPW|fpw) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
mysql --login-path="$FPW_RELEASE_LOGIN_PATH" --batch --show-warnings "$FPW_RELEASE_DB" < "$FPW_RELEASE_SOURCE/database/migrations/20261107_001_guide_route_imports.preflight.sql"
prepared_mysql_commands.backup:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
: "${FPW_RELEASE_BACKUP_FILE:?Set a new protected absolute .sql.gz path outside every webroot}"
test ! -e "$FPW_RELEASE_BACKUP_FILE"
mysqldump --login-path="$FPW_RELEASE_LOGIN_PATH" --single-transaction --routines --triggers --events --hex-blob --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --databases "$FPW_RELEASE_DB" | gzip > "$FPW_RELEASE_BACKUP_FILE"
gzip -t "$FPW_RELEASE_BACKUP_FILE"
shasum -a 256 "$FPW_RELEASE_BACKUP_FILE"

rollback.preferred: Retire/disable new imports and withdraw navigation/publication while retaining the service/schema/readiness guards for existing member copies. Preserve all guide_route_imports snapshots, draft/review state, durable request histories and generated guide_context.
rollback.empty_table_only: The supplied down.sql deliberately errors if any guide_route_imports row exists, then drops only that table. It does not delete My Routes, private waypoints, normalized trips or unrelated Beta data. It requires separately reviewed explicit database selection and an error-stopping client.
rollback.populated_data: Do not run down or delete import records. Export and reconcile guide_route_imports with owned user_routes/user_route_legs/waypoints, loop_routes, route_instances/route_instance_legs, guide_context and geometry overrides before approving a targeted rollback/migration. Preserve stable IDs and request tombstones; removing them permits stale retries and loses null/provenance/review distinctions.
rollback.code_rollback_risk: Restoring pre-guide routeBuilder/floatplan/PDF/map code while guide records remain can remove review gates, revive fallback distance/default-vessel calculations and mislabel exported estimates. Application rollback must keep compatibility and guards for existing guide copies or disable those flows explicitly under a reviewed plan.
rollback.database_restore_risk: Restoring the entire pre-migration database overwrites all subsequent unrelated member/Beta/application activity; the Nov7 local snapshot is not a safe populated rollback. No database restore or down script was executed.
